none: PAS CAM-842AE6: Roman Coin : Copper alloy Nummus of the House of Theodosius
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Nummus of the House of Theodosius. Mint is Illegible. AD388-402, (Reece period 21). Reverse legend [SALVS REI PVBLICAE]. Reverse shows Victory advancing left, holding trophy and dragging a captive. Obverse shows Bust right. Obverse legend [ ]. Condition Fair, die axis is 6 o,clock. Weight 0.96g, diameter 13.27mm
